name: sillytavern-mnemosyne
description: Encrypted, unbounded long-term vector memory for SillyTavern. Total recall, and the vectors are ciphertext on disk.

scripts.types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json

_dependencies_note: Keep both runtime dependencies exactly pinned: `better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers` supplies SQLCipher-enabled SQLite and `sqlite-vec` supplies vector search. Review package-lock.json with every pin change; add runtime dependencies only for a documented security or storage need. Development tools remain devDependencies.
